subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT included in the financial budget of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Credit Control**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Credit control** is NOT included in the financial budget of India.
 
• The financial budget primarily includes **revenue deficit, primary deficit, and fiscal deficit**.
 
• **Revenue deficit** occurs when the net income generated (revenue receipts) is less than the projected net income.
 
• **Primary deficit** is the fiscal deficit of the current year minus the interest payments on previous borrowings.
 
• **Fiscal deficit** is the difference between the government's total expenditure and its total receipts (excluding borrowing).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Credit control** refers to the measures taken by the central bank to control the amount of credit in the economy.
 
• The financial budget is presented annually by the Finance Minister and outlines the government's revenue and expenditure for the upcoming fiscal year.
 
• The budget aims to allocate resources efficiently, manage public finances, and achieve economic stability and growth.
 
• India's financial budget includes various components such as tax revenue, non-tax revenue, capital receipts, and expenditure on different sectors.
 
• Understanding the components of the financial budget is crucial for analyzing the government's fiscal policy and economic strategy.
